title: Single-cell mass cytometry reveals cell type- and cluster-specific heterogeneity in silver nanoparticle responses in a 3D alveolar tetra-culture model
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, 12,4222-4234
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00439J, Paper

Eunseo Lee, Seung-Geun Park, Seung Min Ha, Minseop Kim, Sehee Park, Aline Chary, Tommaso Serchi, Tae Hyun Yoon
Single-cell mass cytometry in a 3D alveolar tetra-culture model uncovers cell-type and cluster-specific heterogeneity in silver nanoparticle association and downstream signaling, revealing mechanistic insights into NP cytotoxicity.
